exposure: prenatal care in a multidisciplinary, prenatal OUD clinic
outcome: Rate of exclusive breastfeeding at maternal discharge
Adherence with prenatal care (≥4 prenatal visits)
Adherence with postpartum care (≥1 postpartum visit)
Postpartum contraception plan prior to delivery
cohort: 210 patients (42 with OUD receiving care at a multidisciplinary OUD clinic and 168 matched controls without OUD)
finding: Patients with OUD who received care at a multidisciplinary OUD clinic were significantly more likely to be breastfeeding at discharge compared to matched controls, despite having lower rates of adequate prenatal care.
mod_finding: The study matched patients with opioid use disorder (OUD) receiving care at a multidisciplinary clinic to controls without OUD based on mode of delivery, race, gestational age, and delivery date.
